Hello, Rachel. Yes, I'm at home and can speak privately. 今天不用赶回公司，时间比较好安排。I've stepped away from the daily management meetings, so my calendar is finally beginning to feel like my own.
That sounds like a change from your usual routine. I'll keep our discussion focused and leave the administrative arrangements until we have covered the review.

That's helpful. I'm trying to spend more time with the family without having the office interrupt everything. The business still calls occasionally, but the team is handling the daily decisions now. I don't need a long discussion today.
Before we turn to the portfolio, please provide your identification number and date of birth for verification.
My identification number is F zero four four seven zero eight seven X. My date of birth is 11 January 1975.
Thank you. Let me distinguish the holdings on the review page. 您持有的子午线亚洲股票基金，是侧重亚洲股票市场的持仓。 另外，猎户座环球收益基金是您现有的债券收益类持仓。
The second one you mentioned is the holding I want to reduce. 我要买。 Sorry, I meant sell, not add to the holding.
I recommend reducing this bond-fund holding because that would release liquidity and lower your exposure to interest-rate and credit-market fluctuations.

Thank you, Rachel. Please keep the review notes concise as well. 我现在看文件，比较喜欢直接找到重点。The secure banking channel is easier for me than having paperwork sent to the office, especially now that I'm not there regularly.

I can use the usual secure channel for the written record. Turning to the review itself, Your objective for this review is to reduce exposure to bond-market fluctuations and release liquidity from your existing holding. For Orion Global Income Fund, rising market interest rates can lower the value of the bonds it holds and depress the fund's unit value. You may lose some or all of your invested capital, and selling below your original purchase price would crystallise a loss. The transaction fee is 0.25% of the transaction amount. Are you willing to accept an investment loss from this sale as part of reducing your exposure?
Yes, I am willing to accept a loss on the sale to reduce my exposure, subject to my minimum execution price.

Thank you. Before we settle the execution details, let's cover the arrangements for future reviews. Would you prefer that I contact you through the secure channel to arrange a call, rather than telephone you without an appointment?

Please send a message to arrange it. 我想把陪家人的时间留出来，不想临时接工作电话。I still want to stay involved in the portfolio, just not have banking calls scattered through the day. A short agenda beforehand would help me decide what documents to have open.

I'll note your preference for an arranged call and a concise agenda. The message can set out the subjects for discussion and any documents you may want nearby. We can arrange the appointment directly with you, without involving your office.

Yes, please keep appointment arrangements with me. My staff are getting used to my being less involved, and I'd rather not pull them back into personal administration. 家里的安排有时候会变，提前发消息比较方便。I can reply when I've checked the calendar.

That is straightforward. If your availability changes, you can use the same channel to ask for another appointment. We can keep future review calls focused on the circulated agenda and leave room for anything you want to raise.

That should work well. I don't want the family plans to become another office schedule. For today's execution details, Use renminbi as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am instructing is 50,000. The quantity is 100 units. Please use a limit order with a minimum execution price of 500 renminbi per unit.
Please confirm your final instruction: sell 100 units of Orion Global Income Fund using a limit order at a minimum price of 500 renminbi per unit, for a transaction amount of 50,000 in renminbi.
I confirm that final instruction as you have just stated it. Please place the order.

Thank you, Daniel. I'll handle the order submission and make the written record available through your usual secure banking channel. Any administrative questions can come directly to me there. Thank you for your time today.
Thanks, Rachel. 后续有文件我会留意安全渠道里的消息。That's everything I wanted to cover today. Goodbye.
